proposal.reason: Main change is in logical graph construction/mapping, so graph-search is primary: src/graph/connect.cc adds channelMap initialization/copying, fixes compCap80/89 channel shuffle ordering, and reapplies ring reversal after node mapping in ncclTopoPostset/connectRings; src/include/graph.h adds channelMap and ringReverse state used by this flow. Secondary network review is warranted for proxy-selection correctness: src/graph/search.cc changes ncclTopoGetNetDev to use execution->graph channelMap and to accept cached proxyDevs only when sender rank and NIC match, otherwise recomputing intermediate proxy path, which affects network proxy routing behavior.
